current_module_for_comparison.note: The edition Biblia Elim ships today. Not modified by this task.

provenance_notes: The task brief said '1835, Miguel de Burgos'. The edition is in fact 1832-1835 in six volumes; 1835 is the year the set was completed, not the year of every volume. The one volume verified here (Tomo III del Antiguo Testamento) has an 1832-range imprint.
The edition statement was read from the object itself, not from a catalogue: the title page of lasagradabiblia01unkngoog reads 'SEGUNDA EDICIÓN' with the Miguel de Burgos imprint.
No source files are stored in this repository. Only this manifest, checksums and reproducible acquisition instructions.
